zh-CN.title: 更流畅的广场阅读体验
items: 广场消息移至搜索旁，发布菜单可查询互动额度，频道两端连续淡出
好友圈更名为好友，成员频道的关闭入口更醒目
瀑布流发言采用滑动图文详情，支持照片信息与直接沉浸看图，列表保留原有详情
聊天中的发言分享统一为瀑布流卡片，适配个性化气泡；StillFolio 照片支持拍摄信息

en.title: A smoother Square reading experience
items: Notifications sit beside search; publishing offers an allowance shortcut, with softly fading channel edges
Member channels have a clearer close control
Masonry posts open swipeable photo details with photo information and direct immersive viewing; lists retain classic details
Shared posts in chats reuse readable masonry cards across bubble themes, with photography information for StillFolio images
